devices.description_en:
Increases the rate of fire.
%(gunReloadTimeFactor) to reload time.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
提升射速。
%(gunReloadTimeFactor) 装填时间。

devices.description_en:
Allows bonuses from consumables and bonuses from abilities in modes to last longer.
%(equipmentDurationFactor) to the duration of consumables and abilities.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
使消耗品和能力提供的加成效果持续时间更长。
%(equipmentDurationFactor)消耗品和能力的持续时间。

devices.description_en: Improves tank maneuverability and firing.
devices.description_zh-Hans: 提高坦克机动性和火力。

devices.description_en:
Increases the chance of penetrating the enemy's armor.
Increases penetration for some shell types.
%(ARMOR_PIERCING) for Armor-Piercing shells,
%(ARMOR_PIERCING_CR) for Armor-Piercing Composite Rigid shells,
%(HOLLOW_CHARGE) for High-Explosive Anti-Tank shells,
%(HIGH_EXPLOSIVE) for High-Explosive shells.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
提升击穿敌人装甲的几率。
提升部分炮弹的穿透深度。
%(ARMOR_PIERCING)穿甲弹，
%(ARMOR_PIERCING_CR)复合穿甲弹，
%(HOLLOW_CHARGE) 高爆反坦克弹，
%(HIGH_EXPLOSIVE)高爆弹。

devices.description_en:
Decreases the aiming time after the tank has moved.
%(gunAimingTimeFactor) to aiming speed.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
降低坦克移动后的瞄准时间。
%(gunAimingTimeFactor)瞄准速度。

devices.description_en:
Allows for more accuracy when shooting while the tank is moving.
%(additiveShotDispersionFactor) to accuracy during tank and turret movement.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
提升坦克移动中攻击的准度。
%(additiveShotDispersionFactor)移动时和炮塔转动时的准度。

devices.description_en:
Increases the chance of hitting the enemy.
%(shotDispersionAngleFactor) to dispersion at 100﻿m.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
增加命中敌人的几率。
%(shotDispersionAngleFactor)100﻿米距离上的误差。

devices.description_en:
Increases the chance of hitting and penetrating from a distance.
%(projectileSpeedFactor) to shell velocity.
%(piercingPenaltyFactor500m) to penetration decrease with distance.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
提升远距离的命中率和穿透率。
%(projectileSpeedFactor)炮弹飞行速度。
%(piercingPenaltyFactor500m)飞行距离损失的穿透力。

devices.description_en:
Increases the durability of modules and reduces damage from ramming.
%(maxHealthPercentageBonus) to track durability.
%(rammingAbsorptionPercent) damage when rammed.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
提高模块的耐久度并降低受到的撞击伤害。
提高%(maxHealthPercentageBonus)履带耐久度。
受到的撞击伤害%(rammingAbsorptionPercent)。

devices.description_en:
Decreases the enemy's chances of dealing damage to your tank's modules and crew.
%(engineEvasionPercentageBonus) to the chance of engine damage.
%(crewEvasionPercentageBonus) to the chance of crew injury.
%(ammoEvasionPercentageBonus) to the chance of ammo rack explosion.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
降低敌人对您的坦克模块和乘员造成冲击伤害的几率：
%(engineEvasionPercentageBonus)损伤引擎的几率。
%(crewEvasionPercentageBonus)损伤乘员的几率。
%(ammoEvasionPercentageBonus)引爆弹药架的几率。

devices.description_en:
Strengthens tank armor.
%(armorHomogenizationFactor) to hull and turret armor.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
强化坦克的装甲。
%(armorHomogenizationFactor)车身和炮塔护甲。

devices.description_en:
Increases tank HP and survivability in battle.
%(maxHpBonusPercent) to tank HP.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
提升坦克生命值和在战斗中的生存能力。
%(maxHpBonusPercent)坦克生命值。

devices.description_en:
Makes the tracks more durable to withstand more damage.
Also, fully repairs the tracks automatically if they're destroyed.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
提高履带的耐久度和承伤能力。
此外，履带被摧毁时会自动完全修复。

devices.description_en: %(repairSpeedFactor) to repair speed for all modules (including the following).
devices.description_zh-Hans: %(repairSpeedFactor)修理速度，适用于所有模块（包含以下）。

devices.description_en:
Increases view range and helps with spotting enemies earlier.
%(circularVisionRadiusFactor) to view range.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
提高视野范围，有助于更早发现敌人。
%(circularVisionRadiusFactor)视野范围。

devices.description_en:
Increases tank concealment at a distance and makes fighting at long range more effective.
%(detectabilityFactor) to concealment when the tank is moving.
The bonus is doubled if the tank remains stationary for %(activateWhenStillSec)﻿s.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
增加坦克在远距离的隐蔽性使之更具远程作战效率。
%(detectabilityFactor)坦克移动时的隐蔽性。
坦克静止%(activateWhenStillSec)﻿秒后效果加倍。

devices.description_en:
Allows for faster responses to enemy actions.
%(rotationSpeedLimit) to the top turn rate of the tank.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
提升对敌人攻击的反应速度。
%(rotationSpeedLimit)坦克最大转向速率。

devices.description_en:
Allows strategic positions to be taken more quickly.
%(enginePower) to engine power.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
更快抵达战略目标地。
%(enginePower)发动机功率。

devices.description_en:
Allows consumables and abilities in modes to be used more often.
%(equipmentReloadBoost) to cooldown speed of consumables and abilities.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
可以在模式中更频繁地使用消耗品和能力。
%(equipmentReloadBoost)消耗品和能力的冷却速度。

devices.description_en: %(highlight_start)+%(circularVisionRadiusIncrease)%%(highlight_end) to view range for a stationary tank, up to 500m.
devices.description_zh-Hans: %(highlight_start)+%(circularVisionRadiusIncrease)%%(highlight_end)坦克静止时的观测范围，最高500米。

devices.description_en:
Increases the durability of modules and reduces damage from ramming.
%(maxHealthPercentageBonus) to track durability.
%(rammingAbsorptionPercent) damage when rammed.
Reduces damage by 10% from High-Explosive shells with a caliber larger than 130 mm.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
提高模块耐久度并降低受到的撞击伤害。
提高%(maxHealthPercentageBonus)履带耐久度。
降低%(rammingAbsorptionPercent)受到的撞击伤害。
130毫米口径以上高爆弹对您的伤害-10%。

devices.description_en:
Decreases the enemy's chances of dealing damage to your tank's modules and crew.
%(engineEvasionPercentageBonus) to the chance of engine damage.
%(crewEvasionPercentageBonus) to the chance of crew injury.
%(ammoEvasionPercentageBonus) to the chance of ammo rack explosion.
-10% to the chance of penetration by enemy High-Explosive shells with a caliber larger than 130﻿mm.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
降低被敌军击伤模块和乘员的几率。
%(engineEvasionPercentageBonus)引擎受伤几率。
%(crewEvasionPercentageBonus)乘员受伤几率。
%(ammoEvasionPercentageBonus)弹药架爆炸几率。
-10%被敌方130﻿毫米以上口径高爆弹攻击的穿透深度。

devices.description_en:
Improves aiming ability.
+%(upperPitchLimitIncrease)° to upper gun turn limit.
+%(lowerPitchLimitIncrease)° to lower gun turn limit.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
提升瞄准能力。
+%(upperPitchLimitIncrease)°火炮上仰角度限制。
+%(lowerPitchLimitIncrease)°火炮下俯角度限制。

devices.description_en:
Enhances terrain crossing capacity on various surfaces.
%(firmGroundPassabilityIncrease) improvement to crossing capacity on roads.
%(mediumGroundPassabilityIncrease) improvement to crossing capacity on ground.
%(softGroundPassabilityIncrease) improvement to crossing capacity on water.
devices.description_zh-Hans:
强化在各种地形上的越野能力。
%(firmGroundPassabilityIncrease)在道路上的越野能力。
%(mediumGroundPassabilityIncrease)在地面上的越野能力。
%(softGroundPassabilityIncrease)在水面上的越野能力。
